articles.summary: MetLife, Inc. (NYSE: MET) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, after the market closes. The earnings news release, financial supplement and related materials will be posted on MetLife’s Investor Relations webpage at investor.metlife.com . MetLife will hold its third quarter 2026 earnings conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026, from 9-10 a.m. (ET) via a live webcast. Please click on the following link to register: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/435085807 . A replay of the webcast will be available at investor.metlife.com for seven days following the call. articles.summary: MetLife, Inc. (NYSE: MET) today announced that its board of directors has declared a fourth quarter 2026 common stock dividend of $0.5925 per share. The dividend will be payable on December 8, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 3, 2026. About MetLife MetLife, Inc.
